title: ischaemum indicum subvar. malacophyllum
intro: Ischaemum indicum subvar. malacophyllum, commonly known as Bengal grass or Malabar grass, is a type of grass native to tropical Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, treating fever, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Ischaemum indicum subvar. malacophyllum include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its use in treating pain, inflammation, and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
